title: A bibliometric analysis of Neuropsychology's published corpus (1987-2024): How has the science evolved, and does study content impact citation rates?
abstract: The objective of the study was to provide an in-depth bibliographic analysis of  A total of 2,403 abstracts published in  Over the past 37 years,  Findings suggest a temporal shift in the field's published content toward more empirically driven, functionally relevant, and contextually informed research. Future bibliographic work is needed to understand how these historical publishing trends align with related disciplines (e.g., behavioral neurology) and to identify the core drivers of citation patterns in neuropsychology.
